result.one_liner: Vercel is a serverless platform for deploying and managing web applications with integrated CI/CD and edge functions.

evidence.quote: Include the token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
Access Tokens can be created and managed from inside your account settings.
All endpoints live under the URL https://api.vercel.com and follow the REST architecture
Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API

result.notes: Vercel provides a comprehensive REST API with bearer token authentication accessible to all users with Vercel accounts. Tokens can be created self-serve from account settings, making this suitable for agent toolkit development. API covers deployments, projects, domains, teams, and other platform management functions.
